BitField NameResetR/WDescription
7:0FREQOFF_ESTR

The estimated frequency offset (2's complement) of the carrier. Resolution is F_{XTAL}/2^{14} (1.59 - 1.65 kHz); range is \pm 202 kHz to \pm 210 kHz, depending on XTAL frequency.

Frequency offset compensation is only supported for 2-FSK, GFSK, 4-FSK, and MSK modulation. This register will read 0 when using ASK or OOK modulation.
